ContractManager instance used to resolve sibling contract addresses and permissions.
Mapping of role hash to RoleData holding the members and the admin role.
Mapping holder => locked token amount maintained by the Punisher contract.
Mapping holder => locked token amount maintained by the TokenLaunchLocker contract.
Mapping of keccak256(contract name) => deployed contract address.
Counter of registered validators, incremented on registerValidator.
Transfers contract ownership to a new address; guarded by onlyOwner.
Renounces ownership and sets _owner to the zero address; guarded by onlyOwner.
Grants a role to an account after checking the caller holds the admin role.
Revokes a role from an account after checking the caller holds the admin role.
Owner-only registration of a sibling contract address into the contracts mapping.
Sends ETH with a low-level call forwarding all gas to an arbitrary recipient.
Returns whether an account has code using extcodehash in inline assembly.
Slashes a validator and its delegations; restricted by allow("SkaleDKG").
Allows an admin to forgive slashed tokens held in _locked; guarded by onlyAdmin.
Adds an amount to _locked[holder]; restricted by allow("DelegationController").
Processes all slashes for a wallet and returns its locked amount.
Transfers accumulated bounty tokens to a destination after a lockup check.
Pays a node bounty and mints tokens through the Distributor contract.
Mints bounty tokens to the Distributor via IMintableToken.mint.
Creates a delegation proposal for msg.sender and checks token balance.
Requests undelegation and removes the amounts from the partial difference sequences.
Validator accepts a delegation proposal; validates msg.sender against the validator address.
Creates a schain after time, lifetime and deposit checks; restricted by allow("SkaleManager").
Computes and pays the bounty for a node, refilling and reducing the epoch pool.
Registers a new node; checks IP, name, port and public key binding to the caller.
Verifies the validator has sufficient delegated stake to create another node.
Verifies a BLS signature using G1/G2 checks and a bn256 pairing precompile.
Recovers the signer address from a signature, rejecting malleable s and v values.
Modular exponentiation implemented through a staticcall to precompile 5.
Initializes roles, assigns DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to msg.sender and sets the contract manager.
Caller address supplied by the transaction origin and used for authorization and ownership.
Block timestamp used as now for reward, schain and lockup timing decisions.
Outbound external call to an arbitrary or derived address (call{value:} or ERC777/ERC20 transfer).
ecrecover precompile invocation whose return value may be the zero address for invalid signatures.
Unsigned subtraction and partial difference computations (boundedSub / subtractFromValue / sub) that can underflow if invariants break.
Pseudo-random node and monitor selection derived from blockhash and block values, which is miner-influenceable.
Staticcall to elliptic curve precompiles (bigModExp, bn256ScalarMul, bn256Pairing) whose success is only required to be true.
New owner address argument of transferOwnership.
Wei amount forwarded by Address.sendValue.
Wallet address whose locked amount is forgiven.
Validator identifier to be slashed.
Human readable contract name hashed into the contract id.
Destination address receiving the withdrawn bounty tokens.
Boolean return flag of the low-level call inside Address.sendValue.
Extcodehash result compared against the empty-code hash inside Address.isContract.

edges.reason: transferOwnership is protected by onlyOwner which compares _owner with _msgSender() (msg.sender).
renounceOwnership can only be called by the current owner (msg.sender).
grantRole requires msg.sender to hold the admin role of the target role.
revokeRole requires msg.sender to hold the admin role of the target role.
setContractsAddress is restricted to the owner through onlyOwner.
slash is guarded by allow("SkaleDKG") which compares msg.sender to a registered contract address.
forgive is guarded by onlyAdmin which resolves msg.sender through _isAdmin.
withdrawBounty derives the withdrawable bounty and the transfer entitlement from msg.sender.
delegate records msg.sender as the delegation holder address.
acceptPendingDelegation validates msg.sender against the validator address of the delegation.
createNode uses msg.sender to verify node ownership and public key binding.
initialize grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to msg.sender.
The recovered signer returned by recover is compared with msg.sender or a claimed node address by callers.
addSchain requires now >= schainCreationTimeStamp, a block.timestamp dependency.
calculateBounty requires the next reward timestamp to be <= now (block.timestamp).
getBounty relies on isTimeForReward which compares the reward timestamp with now.
createNode stores block.timestamp as the node lastRewardDate inside _addNode.
Block values combined with blockhash drive the pseudo-random selection of nodes and monitors.
sendValue forwards value with recipient.call{value: amount}("") handing control to an arbitrary address.
withdrawBounty performs an outbound token transfer to a caller supplied destination.
_payBounty mints tokens through an external IMintableToken call resolved from ContractManager.
recover invokes the ecrecover precompile to derive the signer.
verify ends with a bn256Pairing staticcall to precompile 8.
bigModExp performs a staticcall to precompile 5 and only checks the success flag.
addSchain leads to _generateGroup which picks nodes using blockhash derived randomness.
calculateBounty subtracts the payout from _epochPool and partial difference subtractions rely on boundedSub.
requestUndelegation removes amounts from partial difference values and sequences using unsigned subtraction.
_owner is the authority compared in the onlyOwner guard of transferOwnership.
_owner is checked and then cleared by renounceOwnership.
_roles stores the role membership and admin role consulted by grantRole.
_roles stores the role membership and admin role consulted by revokeRole.
_roles is populated with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE during initialize.
contractManager.getContract resolves the authorised caller inside the allow modifier.
contractManager is used by _isAdmin to resolve the SkaleManager admin role.
getBounty resolves the Nodes, Bounty and Monitors contracts through contractManager.
setContractsAddress writes the resolved contract address into the contracts mapping.
forgive reduces or deletes _locked[holder].
handleSlash increases _locked[holder] with the slashed amount.
_getAndUpdateLockedAmount returns the value stored in _locked[wallet].
acceptPendingDelegation resolves the validator address registered in validator maps keyed by id.
newOwner is validated and stored into _owner.
amount is used as the value forwarded in the low-level call.
holder keys the _locked mapping inside forgive.
validatorId is used to look up the validator and confiscate its delegations.
contractsName is hashed into the contractId used as the contracts mapping key.
to is the destination address of the bounty token transfer.
success stores the boolean return value of the external call in sendValue.
codehash holds the extcodehash result compared against the empty code hash.

The parameter is only hashed and stored by setContractsAddress.
The parameter is only used as the transfer destination inside withdrawBounty.
The local variable only holds the external call result checked inside sendValue.
The local variable only holds the extcodehash result compared inside isContract.
